'''Sanin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an Equipment Commendations Vendor on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sanin appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Modification Commendations Vendor for Republic players on Hoth.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Sanin was removed from the game along with the rest of the Equipment Commendations Vendors.<ref name="TOR" /> His position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
